import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] powerSeries = new long[18];

    static long computeCost(long val, int level) {
        long times = val / powerSeries[level];
        if (val % powerSeries[level] == 0)
            return level * times;
        long cost1 = level * times + computeCost(val % powerSeries[level], level - 1);
        long cost2 = level * (times + 1) + computeCost(powerSeries[level] - (val % powerSeries[level]), level - 1);
        return Math.min(cost1, cost2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        powerSeries[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 17; ++i) {
            powerSeries[i] = powerSeries[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long input = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(computeCost(input, 17));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
